/usr/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
class Check(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.ids = set()
        self.links = []
        self.stack = []
        self.h1 = []
        self.in_h1 = False
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        a = dict(attrs)
        assert tag not in ('script', 'video'), tag
        if 'id' in a:
            assert a['id'] not in self.ids
            self.ids.add(a['id'])
        if tag == 'a': self.links.append(a.get('href', ''))
        if 'src' in a: assert Path(a['src']).is_file(), a['src']
        if tag == 'h1': self.in_h1 = True
        if tag not in ('meta', 'img', 'path', 'link', 'br', 'hr', 'input'): self.stack.append(tag)
    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):
        self.handle_starttag(tag, attrs)
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        assert self.stack and self.stack.pop() == tag, tag
        if tag == 'h1': self.in_h1 = False
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.in_h1: self.h1.append(data)
p = Check()
s = Path('index.html').read_text()
p.feed(s)
assert not p.stack
assert ''.join(p.h1) == 'A quiet study.'
assert 'An independent film practice.' in s and 'Selected work' in s
assert '#work' in p.links and 'work' in p.ids
assert all(x.startswith('#') for x in p.links)
assert 'http://' not in s and 'https://' not in s
assert s.count('{') == s.count('}')
print('PASS: source structure, required content, local assets, fragment links, CSS brace balance; no scripts, video, or external URLs.')
PY"
